name: Add a chat moderator
description: Add a chat moderator Adds a moderator to the authenticated broadcaster's persistent list and returns the updated moderator user IDs. POST /2/broadcasts/chat/moderators
context:
POST /2/broadcasts/chat/moderators
Adds a moderator to the authenticated broadcaster's persistent list and returns the updated moderator user IDs. The list applies to all current and future broadcast chats.
Required: body (body)

name: Create a scheduled broadcast
description: Create a scheduled broadcast Schedules a one-off or recurring broadcast for the authenticated user. POST /2/broadcasts/scheduled
context:
POST /2/broadcasts/scheduled
Schedules a one-off or recurring broadcast for the authenticated user. A `source_id` (ingest) is required at create time.
Required: body (body)

name: Remove a chat message from a live broadcast
description: Remove a chat message from a live broadcast Removes a specific chat message from a running broadcast where the authenticated user is the host or a moderator. DELETE /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat/{message_id}

name: Delete a scheduled broadcast
description: Delete a scheduled broadcast Deletes a scheduled broadcast by its alphanumeric UBS broadcast id. DELETE /2/broadcasts/scheduled/{id}
context:
DELETE /2/broadcasts/scheduled/{id}
Deletes a scheduled broadcast by its alphanumeric UBS broadcast id.
Required: id (path)
Optional: roll_forward (query)

name: Get a broadcast
description: Get a broadcast Returns a broadcast owned by the authenticated user. GET /2/broadcasts/{id}
context:
GET /2/broadcasts/{id}
Returns a broadcast owned by the authenticated user.
Required: id (path)
Optional: broadcast.fields (query) — A comma separated list of Broadcast fields to display.

name: Get broadcast chat history
description: Get broadcast chat history Returns newest-first chat messages for a broadcast owned by the authenticated user. GET /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat
context:
GET /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat
Returns newest-first chat messages for a broadcast owned by the authenticated user.
Required: id (path)
Optional: max_results (query); pagination_token (query) — A 64-bit signed integer.; broadcast_chat_message.fields (query) — A comma separated list of BroadcastChatMessage fields to display.; expansions (query) — A comma separated list of fields to expand.; user.fields (query) — A comma separated list of User fields to display.

name: Get chat moderators
description: Get chat moderators Returns the authenticated broadcaster's persistent moderators as User resources. GET /2/broadcasts/chat/moderators
context:
GET /2/broadcasts/chat/moderators
Returns the authenticated broadcaster's persistent moderators as User resources. The list applies to all of their current and future broadcast chats.
Optional: user.fields (query) — A comma separated list of User fields to display.; expansions (query) — A comma separated list of fields to expand.; post.fields (query) — A comma separated list of Post fields to display.

name: Get a scheduled broadcast
description: Get a scheduled broadcast Returns a single scheduled broadcast by its alphanumeric UBS broadcast id. GET /2/broadcasts/scheduled/{id}

name: Go live on a scheduled broadcast
description: Go live on a scheduled broadcast Publishes a schedule that was created or updated with `manual_publish: true`. POST /2/broadcasts/scheduled/{id}/live
context:
POST /2/broadcasts/scheduled/{id}/live
Publishes a schedule that was created or updated with `manual_publish: true`. Without that flag the coordinator auto-publishes at start and this call is rejected.
Required: id (path)

name: List broadcasts
description: List broadcasts Returns the authenticated user's live-video broadcasts, or selected owned broadcasts when ids are provided. GET /2/broadcasts
context:
GET /2/broadcasts
Returns the authenticated user's live-video broadcasts, or selected owned broadcasts when ids are provided. At most one of `ids`, `max_results` may be provided. At most one of `ids`, `pagination_token` may be provided.
Optional: ids (query) — Comma-separated broadcast IDs to retrieve instead of listing broadcasts.; max_results (query); pagination_token (query); broadcast.fields (query) — A comma separated list of Broadcast fields to display.

name: List scheduled broadcasts
description: List scheduled broadcasts Returns scheduled broadcasts owned by the authenticated user. GET /2/broadcasts/scheduled
context:
GET /2/broadcasts/scheduled
Returns scheduled broadcasts owned by the authenticated user.
Optional: max_results (query); oldest_start_time (query); newest_start_time (query); pagination_token (query)

name: Mute or time out a user in a broadcast chat
description: Mute or time out a user in a broadcast chat Prevents a user from posting further messages in a running broadcast chat. POST /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat/mutes
context:
POST /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat/mutes
Prevents a user from posting further messages in a running broadcast chat. When `end_at_ms` is provided, the mute expires at that time. The authenticated user must be the broadcast host or a moderator.
Required: id (path); body (body)

name: Remove a chat moderator
description: Remove a chat moderator Removes a moderator from the authenticated broadcaster's persistent list and returns the updated moderator user IDs. DELETE /2/broadcasts/chat/moderators/{user_id}

name: Send a chat message to a live broadcast
description: Send a chat message to a live broadcast Posts a chat message to a running broadcast, attributed to the authenticated user. POST /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat
context:
POST /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat
Posts a chat message to a running broadcast, attributed to the authenticated user.
Required: id (path); body (body)

name: Unmute a user in a broadcast chat
description: Unmute a user in a broadcast chat Allows a muted user to post messages in a running broadcast chat again. DELETE /2/broadcasts/{id}/chat/mutes/{user_id}

name: Update a scheduled broadcast
description: Update a scheduled broadcast Fully replaces schedule fields for a broadcast. PUT /2/broadcasts/scheduled/{id}
